**watcher, poller and SSE hub wire A2 into brain:ui**

Slice 2 (PR 2 / A2) of #881 lands the process's long-running pieces: watcher.mjs (directory-only fs.watch over Q3's committed-tier set, 250ms trailing debounce, worktree re-scan via a duplicated git-worktree-list grammar, per-directory failure surfaced never thrown), poller.mjs (fast/review/body lanes under the Q1/D2 rate budget, pause/resume/once with 5s collapse, a failed poll never empties a filled section), and server.mjs's SSE hub (GET /api/stream: sync then section/refs/status frames, one in-memory current snapshot shared with /api/snapshot) plus the three POST /api/poll/* controls (405 everywhere else) and the D15 SIGINT/SIGTERM lifecycle with --interval/--no-poll. Fixed a real leak along the way: poller.close() now marks itself closed so an in-flight tick's own reschedule cannot arm a timer after shutdown. Full suite 5389/5389 green.
